products.body_html:
DIY Lash Cluster Kit - 120 Mixed Length Eyelash Clusters

Create your own lash look with this DIY eyelash cluster kit. Featuring 120 clusters in lengths from 8 mm to 16 mm, the set lets you customize your style, from subtle everyday definition to a fuller, fluttery finish.

Combine shorter clusters at the inner corners with longer lengths toward the outer corners for a graduated look, or experiment with different placements to suit your makeup.

Why You’ll Love It

  • 120 lash clusters: A 10 row tray gives you plenty of options for creating your look.
  • Five mixed lengths: Includes 8 mm, 10 mm, 12 mm, 14 mm, and 16 mm clusters.
  • Customizable placement: Apply individual clusters where you want added length and volume.
  • Soft, wispy appearance: Synthetic fibers create a fluttery, layered effect.
  • DIY convenience: The kit brings together lash clusters, bond and seal, and an applicator.

Product Details

  • Type: Individual cluster false eyelashes
  • Material: Synthetic fibers
  • Color: Black
  • Quantity: 120 clusters across 10 rows
  • Lengths: 8-16 mm
  • Tray dimensions: Approximately 9.5 × 13.5 cm

What’s Included

  • 1 × tray of 120 mixed length lash clusters
  • 1 × lash bond and seal
  • 1 × lash applicator

How to Use

Start with clean, dry lashes. Follow the included bond and seal instructions, then use the applicator to position each cluster carefully. Combine lengths to create your preferred shape and finish.

Care & Removal

Gently remove adhesive residue from reusable clusters and store them in their tray. Use a suitable lash adhesive remover and follow the adhesive’s removal instructions; avoid pulling clusters off.

For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes and discontinue use if irritation occurs. Package contents apply to the kit shown; other variants may differ.
